end.summary:
Harsh identified (3, 5) as Quadrant I because both coordinates are positive.
They practised quadrant signs and identified the origin as (0, 0), which is not in any quadrant.
Harsh initially treated (3, 2) and (2, 3) as the same point.
Using the cinema seat example, they corrected this and stated: move along x first, then y.
Teach-back was not passed; one unaided point-reading/plotting response was correct across six attempts.
end.parentNote: Asha practised quadrant signs, the origin, and reading an ordered pair by moving along x first and then y. Harsh explained the cinema-seat comparison and corrected the mix-up that (3, 2) and (2, 3) are different points. At home, ask them to plot a few pairs such as (2, 3) and (3, 2), saying the horizontal and vertical moves aloud.
